title: Leçon 1 — greet someone and take my leave, choosing the right formality and time of day

meta.title: Greetings & goodbyes
meta.can_do: I can greet someone and take my leave, choosing the right formality and time of day.

beats.text: Here's the goal: greet people in French, and say goodbye — the right way for the moment.
visuals: GOAL CARD — can-do text

beats.text: This is lesson one — nothing to bring back yet. Get ready to speak out loud.
Listen to two people meet and part. Understand what you can.
How many people are speaking, and where are they? Answer out loud, in English.
In France bonjour is not optional. Entering a shop and asking a question without it reads as rude. Greet first, then ask.

beats.text: You walk into a bakery. A woman is behind the counter. Greet her using whichever greeting fits the time where you are right now, and thank her. Say it out loud, then write it down.
visuals: SCENE — You walk into a bakery. A woman is behin · WORD BANK:  · MIC

beats.text: Here is one way. If yours differs but the pieces fit, it’s right.
You are leaving that same bakery and will be back tomorrow. Thank her and say goodbye in a way that means you will see her again. Say it out loud, then write it down.
